message: Added ECC as an opt-in multi-harness catalog skill; setup now requires explicit provider target, scope, hook, and duplicate-install checks.
Added Headroom as a full-mode context layer: reuse healthy deployment state, keep Graphify preflight read-only, and enforce source edits only through the documented Claude Code hook.

Catalog 251->358: vendored pm-skills(65+1), langchain-skills(10), higgsfield-ai(8), k-skill(5), oh-my-gods(17) at pinned commits; oh-my-gods vendored despite agenticskills installer because user chose standalone jeo-skill install. Excluded previously-removed/retired skills, OMC/OMX/ooo command shims, router-covered sub-skills, and 6 unattributed singles. Restored llm-wiki knowledge-pipeline hooks in setup Step 5; committed generate-catalog-projections.py; .mex/ and root anchors stay untracked by user choice.

Promoted the independent shopping-shorts account skill into the canonical 359-skill catalog after portability cleanup and 79-case media regression validation; kept 26 retired or deliberately deleted global leftovers excluded. Pushed commit 2830081 to main.

Duplicate audit 359->350: merged 9 same-JTBD pairs into canonical skills (content absorbed into references/, old names in retired_skills, route-outs repointed); adjacent-but-different overlaps declared as relationship_groups (llm-observability, bug-diagnosis, product-analytics) rather than merged; upstream sibling splits and provider choices left alone.

Installer compatibility uses shared jeopi/JEO/OMP roots but projects selected files into GJC-native, Aside-account and separate AGY CLI/IDE roots. Actual skills@1.7.0 writes proved advertised target metadata alone is insufficient. Verified isolated real installs and session loaders; provider plugins/hooks unchanged.

Installer documentation must be exercised, not merely parsed: a trailing JEO_SKILLS_DRY_RUN=true argument passed bash syntax checks while installing. Added offline fixture execution of both documented preview commands with unchanged-filesystem assertions; standalone legacy shared-router upgrade regression also passes. Public recipes must use a documented checkout root. Actual user HOME and ECC settings remain untouched.

Installer follow-up verified exact documented preview and apply commands, preserving minimal/core/full runtime selections. Shell syntax alone missed an environment assignment after the command; behavioral fixture tests now guard it. All 34 installer, 6 loader-probe, and 24 configuration-writer checks passed. Actual user installations and ECC settings unchanged.

Ubuntu CI caught GNU stat -f filesystem output contaminating Agentation's inline permission fallback. Adopted existing plannotator Darwin/GNU mode dispatch in Agentation and the test helper, preserving exact 640/600 assertions. Obsidian's separate command assignments are not affected. Local configuration suite24 passes; corrective remote CI pending.

Router review: explicit catalog overrides fail closed across browse/install/doctor; share bounded Node/npx prerequisites so doctor cannot report false readiness; reject negative search limits. No npm release was invented: this repo distributes via GitHub and has no root package target.

Context-layer lifecycle policy decided via Path B interview (MCP timed out): hybrid triggers (TaskCompleted inline + SessionEnd detached refresh; per-repo pre-push checkpoint chained before git-lfs), archive-then-30d-TTL for authored pages, raw/ exempt, regenerable caches deleted+rebuilt, per-layer locks shared with ingest producers, single vault SSoT ~/vaults/llm-wiki, graphify-out/ canonical with deletion-aware reconciliation, mex-agent 0.8.3 upgrade. Seed + 6 research reports under .ouroboros/.

ctx lifecycle tool implemented and verified (12/12 seed ACs, 6 self-tests). Ouroboros run cancelled: worktree containment nulls out-of-repo context refs, so the seed was executed directly via 4 parallel builders. Design facts: zg status rewrites index segments (plan() must never shell out); SessionEnd 1.5s budget -> detached refresh; pre-push hook resolved via git rev-parse --git-path for linked worktrees; .moving consolidation dirs resumable, never rmtree; orphan-index GC fails closed on any surviving root or live lease. 3 real checkpoints: 42.6MB deleted, 27 pages + 2 roots archived, raw/ byte-identical.

Jev remains an explicit home-scoped opt-in, separate from catalog transport and host rule adoption. Configuration/readiness are distinct; outages and malformed decisions fail closed. Verified a real local Ollama prune without modifying installed configuration.

Jevgrep is a separate opt-in source-discovery lane, not a Jev control-plane replacement. jeo-skill explore requires an explicit root and per-call remote-content consent; native catalog/exact/LSP/zvec/Graphify routes stay default. Published @dzhng/jevgrep@0.8.0 transport passed isolated loopback checks across skills/wiki/graph-source roots (12 POSTs), not live-provider retrieval quality. Twelve focused regressions and independent code/Python reviews passed.
